items.title: New mixing benchmark could help industry reduce energy use in stirred tanks
items.summary: Solid–liquid mixing, where particles are dispersed in a liquid, is essential in many industrial processes such as slurry preparation, crystallization, precipitation, adsorption and dissolution. Floating particles often pose a challenge in mixing because they are lighter than the liquid and tend to float at its surface. items.title: Ancient teeth confirm Homo erectus survived in southern China's dense tropical forests
items.summary: Our distant relative, Homo erectus, survived for nearly 2 million years, far longer than our species, Homo sapiens, has survived. The extinct species of archaic human spread from Africa across Asia as far as China and Java in Indonesia through grasslands and woodland savannas. Despite evidence of these achievements, our understanding of their flexibility, preferred environmental conditions, ability to adapt and even the causes of their extinction is still very limited.
